pages.title: Functional Blocks
pages.text: These blocks provide utility and interact directly with Hexalia's systems, from protection to storage and farming.

pages.title: Dreamcatcher
pages.text: A defensive block that protects against phantoms. When fueled with a Fire Node, it becomes active at night, weakening and burning nearby phantoms.

pages.title: Shelf
pages.text: A storage block designed for brews and potions, allowing organized placement of multiple bottles.

pages.title: Infused Soil
pages.text: Infused Dirt and Farmland enhance plant growth and simplify farming. They allow herbs to be cultivated and remove the need for water or careful maintenance.

pages.title: Herb Jar
pages.text: Stores up to 8 valid ingredients of one kind. Right-click with a matching item to insert it; use an empty hand to take one out. The jar keeps its contents when broken and carried.

pages.title: Nesting Block
pages.text: A block used in Silk Moth farming. It attracts egg laying and stores hatched silkworms for later extraction.
